title: Illegal analytical form (one JSONL line)
description: One entry of the illegal-form corpus for ARCH-ANALYTICAL-RELATION-001. Each line of illegal-forms.jsonl conforms to this schema. An entry is an asserted projection that the analytical type system must reject, the fact that makes it ill-typed, and the diagnostic the rejection carries. Shape only is enforced here; term membership, form-name leaks, engine coverage and doctrine drift are checked by packages/ds-codegen/src/analytical/corpus-integrity.ts.

id.description: The diagnostic code the engine emits when it rejects this projection. Unique within the corpus and equal to a row in the doctrine's corpus table.

engine.description: The checkability engine that fires. Must equal vocabulary.json `engines` (drift-gated).

asserted.description: The projection being asserted, in L3-L4 vocabulary (derivations, coordinate space, channels, task). Never a form name.

cause.description: The L0-L3 fact that makes the assertion ill-typed. Never a form name.

terms.description: The namespaced vocabulary terms the entry is written in (namespace:term). Every term must resolve in vocabulary.json; this is the mechanical form of the stage-0 falsifier.

colloquial.description: What a practitioner would call this. Exempt from the form-name denylist; exists to show the name is downstream of the cause.
